idea: How to detect a leaking toilet
title: Simple Test for Hidden Toilet Leaks
description: A leaking toilet can waste hundreds of gallons of water every month without making a sound. The easiest way to check for a silent leak is the food coloring test. Remove the tank lid and drop a few drops of dark food coloring into the water inside the tank. Wait about fifteen to twenty minutes without flushing. If color appears in the toilet bowl, your flapper valve is worn out and allowing water to seep through. Replacing a worn flapper is a quick, inexpensive fix that saves water and keeps your utility bills down. Check your toilets twice a year to catch small issues early.
